feeds.title: New Hampshire Public Radio » Arts & Culture
feeds.description: New Hampshire Public Radio serves as the state's sole radio news provider, broadcasting from 14 locations statewide. Trusted journalism enriches lives and fosters community cohesion, both within New Hampshire and extending its impact beyond the Granite State's borders.

feeds.title: Arts4NH Blog
feeds.description: Arts4NH is dedicated to highlighting the crucial role of arts and culture in New Hampshire's creative economy and community fabric. Through community building, communication, and advocacy, Arts4NH fosters an environment where diverse artistic experiences are valued and celebrated at all levels.

feeds.title: Claire Leach Blog
feeds.description: Claire Leach, born in 1988, is a Hampshire-based artist known for her exquisite landscape and nature paintings. With a BA (Hons) in Fine Art from the University of Gloucestershire and an MA from Winchester School of Art, her work showcases intricate details and layers, capturing the essence of woodlands through ink and brush techniques.

feeds.title: Tracy Meola Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: Tracy, a professional artist based in East Hampstead, NH, specializes in contemporary acrylic still-life realism painting. With a love for graphite sketching and watercolour, she employs a unique technique of layering paint to achieve a soft, blended look. Tracy's works, crafted in her in-home studio, exhibit a delicate smoothness despite multiple layers of paint.

feeds.title: The Hippo » Visual Arts
feeds.description: The Hippo, part of Quality of Life Publications, is Southern New Hampshire's premier weekday publication, reaching over 34,000 readers. Dedicated to enhancing the region's quality of life, it offers insights on everything from dining and family activities to outdoor adventures and live entertainment, reflecting the essence of living in the area.

feeds.title: Portsmouth Music & Arts Center Blog
feeds.description: Portsmouth Music and Arts Center, a nonprofit community school, fosters creativity and inclusivity, offering opportunities for all to thrive regardless of age or economic status. Through quality education and diverse artistic experiences, PMAC builds community and empowers individuals to reach their creative potential.

feeds.title: Monadnock Arts Alive Blog
feeds.description: Arts Alive is a nonprofit arts organization dedicated to enriching the Monadnock region's quality of life through arts and creativity. They advocate for access to arts and culture as a human right, supporting creative businesses and promoting the local creative economy. Explore Monadnock's vibrant arts scene with Arts Alive!

feeds.title: Brothers Judd Blog » Art
feeds.description: Brothers Judd Blog offers diverse content spanning technology, religion, health, food, history, arts, books, culture, and more. Explore their Art section for captivating articles, videos, reviews, and enriching insights into various artistic genres and expressions.

feeds.title: Patricia S. Gordon Fine Art Blog
feeds.description: With roots near Virginia's Blue Ridge Mountains, Patricia S. Gordon pursued her passion for art, earning a BA in Fine Arts/Art History. For over 20 years, she's been showcased in New England galleries. Inspired by tonalist painters, she crafts ethereal pieces with oil paint, capturing subtle tonal shifts to evoke a dreamlike ambience.

feeds.title: Creative Ventures Gallery Blog
feeds.description: Since July 2015, Creative Ventures Gallery, a Milford, New Hampshire LLC, has fostered artistic enrichment for artists, students, and the public. Through art classes, lectures, and exhibitions, they cultivate creativity. Combining studios, galleries, and classrooms, Creative Ventures is a hub for artistic expression. Explore their blog for insights on local art shows, summer camps, painting tips, and more!

feeds.title: Seacoast Artist Association
feeds.description: The Seacoast Artist Association, nestled in the scenic New Hampshire seacoast, is a vibrant hub for artists and art enthusiasts alike. With a focus on fostering creativity and supporting local talent, the association actively promotes art appreciation and offers various services to artists of all ages and mediums. Notably, their Scholarship Fund extends a helping hand to high school seniors passionate about pursuing art beyond graduation.

feeds.title: Arts In Reach Blog
feeds.description: Since 1997, Arts In Reach has empowered teens in southeastern New Hampshire and Maine through arts programs and mentoring. Committed to equity, AIR offers free, inclusive programs, bridging opportunity gaps based on gender, health, race, and more. By celebrating teens' uniqueness, AIR cultivates hope and fosters pathways to brighter futures in education, career, and life.

feeds.title: Deidre Noreen Blair Blog
feeds.description: Deidre Noreen Blair, an oil painter based in the White Mountains of New Hampshire, draws inspiration from her diverse upbringing in a military family. With a degree in Studio Arts from Portland State University, her bold and whimsical works reflect a deep connection to nature and admiration for artists across time and place.

feeds.title: Brandy M Patterson Blog
feeds.description: Brandy M. Patterson, a resident of Manchester, New Hampshire, resides with her husband and son. Endowed with synesthesia, she possesses a unique ability to intertwine sound and colour, crafting vibrant compositions that capture the essence of music's evolution. Through her art, she explores rhythmic qualities and tonalities, offering studio insights and playful tips to inspire creativity.

feeds.title: City Arts Nashua
feeds.description: City Arts Nashua, a volunteer arts services organization, holds IRS non-profit status. Their mission: Enriching life quality by providing leadership to bolster arts and culture. Comprising visual artists, writers, business leaders, and art enthusiasts, they're dedicated to nurturing Greater Nashua's artistic and cultural landscape.

feeds.title: New Hampshire Business Committee for the Arts
feeds.description: The New Hampshire Business Committee for the Arts (NHBCA) is dedicated to fostering business support and involvement in the arts. Through advocacy and facilitation, NHBCA promotes the economic and social benefits of arts engagement, serving as a bridge between businesses, artists, and cultural organizations statewide.

feeds.title: Wolfgang Ertl Art Blog
feeds.description: Wolfgang Ertl, a literature scholar turned artist, blends abstraction with representation in his vibrant paintings. Now residing in Hampton, NH, he explores landscapes across the globe through pastels, oils, and acrylics. His work, featured in exhibitions and galleries, captures atmosphere and light with creative stylization and abstraction.
